name: Shenzhen Camsense Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Camsense Technologies Co., Ltd. develops high precision positioning vision systems for professional and consumer applications. It offers a portable high-precision positioning system for use in medical surgery navigation and industrial manufacturing sectors; a high-precision positioning system for use in testing agency, service robot, unmanned aerial vehicle, and VR manufacturing markets; a consumer level lidar; and a VR/AR tracking system. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
